sector_model: nonfinancial consumer and commercial services (pest control); GAAP earnings, FCF after capex, debt from commercial paper plus senior notes, acquisition-driven growth
thesis: Rollins (Orkin; residential, commercial and termite pest control; recurring contract base) reported Q3 2026 revenue +6.2% to 1,089.7M (organic +4.4%) but operating margin fell 140 bp to 20.5%, adjusted EBITDA -0.7%, and management said residential customer acquisition remained under pressure. Close 37.95 on 2026-11-06 (NYSE) gives market cap about 18.14B on 478.0M shares; TTM GAAP net income 526.1M (34.5x), TTM FCF 671.8M (3.7%; about 3.4% excluding a 63.0M Q3 tax refund timing benefit). Very low capital intensity and light leverage, but earnings are flat over nine months.
counterthesis: Earnings are not growing: 9M26 net income 409.7M vs 410.3M, diluted EPS 0.85 vs 0.85, on revenue +8.0%, so acquisitions and price are not reaching profit. Organic growth slowed to 4.4% in Q3, the 2026 organic guide is 4% to 6%, the adjusted incremental EBITDA margin guide is slightly positive to 10%, and management called Q3 disappointing with residential acquisition under pressure. At about 34x earnings the price still assumes a return to higher organic growth and margin expansion. Q3 operating cash flow included 63.0M of tax refund timing. Dividends (263.1M), buybacks (162.9M) and acquisitions (162.6M) in 9M26 total 588.6M against OCF less capex of 512.8M, funded partly by commercial paper (239.6M, up from 123.7M). Goodwill 1.47B exceeds equity 1.39B. Customer retention, rest of MD&A, FY2025 10-K audit matters and peers not read.
invalidation: Organic revenue growth below 4% for two consecutive quarters; full-year operating margin below 19%; residential customer count declines; net debt/EBITDA above 1.5x; FCF conversion below 90% of net income after normalizing tax timing; large acquisition goodwill impairment.
